name: pinned-tabs-and-folders-order-as-one-list
description:
Folders are items of the pinned list and order freely with pinned tabs. Four gestures, each a synthetic dragstart/dragover/drop against the running sidebar, the same events installRowDrag listens for: a pinned tab dropped on a folder head joins the folder, a member dragged out lands in the pinned run where it was dropped, a pinned folder head reorders among the pinned tabs, and a folder from the head of the section drops into the run and becomes one of its items. Then a relaunch reads the order back from the document.

The fixture's space pins four tabs, two of them members of the Work folder, and holds one regular folder, News, with one member.

actions.expression: (() => { const zone = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) .foldin[data-dropzone="pinned"]'); if (!zone) { return 'no-zone'; } const title = (r) => (r.querySelector('.tl') || r).textContent.trim(); const items = [...zone.children].filter((el) => el.matches('.tabrow, .frow')).map((el) => el.matches('.frow') ? 'F:' + el.dataset.folderId.slice(0, 4) + '[' + [...el.nextElementSibling.querySelectorAll('.tabrow')].map(title).join('+') + ']' : title(el)); const legacy = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) .folderlist > .frow')].map((h) => 'F:' + h.dataset.folderId.slice(0, 4)); return items.join(' | ') + ' // folders ' + (legacy.join(' | ') || 'none'); })()
actions.expected: Pin One | F:1111[Work A+Work B] | Pin Two // folders F:2222

actions.expression: (() => { const pane = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane)'); const title = (r) => (r.querySelector('.tl') || r).textContent.trim(); const rows = [...pane.querySelectorAll('.tabrow')]; const heads = [...pane.querySelectorAll('.frow[data-folder-id]')]; const find = (key) => key.startsWith('F:') ? heads.find((h) => h.dataset.folderId.startsWith(key.slice(2))) : rows.find((r) => title(r) === key); const src = find("Pin Two"); const dst = find("F:1111"); if (!src || !dst) { return 'missing ' + (src ? '' : 'src ') + (dst ? '' : 'dst'); } if (!src.draggable) { return 'source not draggable'; } const dt = new DataTransfer(); src.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragstart', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: dt})); const rect = dst.getBoundingClientRect(); const clientX = rect.left + 20; const clientY = rect.top + rect.height * 0.5; dst.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragover', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: dt, clientX, clientY})); dst.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('drop', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: dt, clientX, clientY})); src.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragend', {bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: dt})); return 'dropped Pin Two on the Work head'; })()
